name: E-commerce Dashboard
description: Sales analytics, order management, product catalog, and customer insights

frontend.name: 01_header.txt
frontend.content: Create a modern e-commerce header with logo, search bar, cart icon (with badge), user avatar dropdown. Include a dark mode toggle. Use Tailwind CSS classes.

frontend.name: 02_sidebar.txt
frontend.content: Create a collapsible sidebar with navigation: Dashboard, Orders, Products, Customers, Analytics, Settings. Use icons from Font Awesome.

frontend.name: 03_sales_chart.txt
frontend.content: Create a sales analytics card with a line chart showing daily revenue for the last 30 days. Use Chart.js. Include total revenue, growth percentage, and order count.

frontend.name: 04_stat_cards.txt
frontend.content: Create 4 stat cards: Total Revenue, Total Orders, Conversion Rate, Average Order Value. Each card has an icon, main number, and trend indicator (up/down arrow).

frontend.name: 05_recent_orders.txt
frontend.content: Create a recent orders table with columns: Order ID, Customer, Date, Status, Amount. Include a filter dropdown and pagination.

frontend.name: 06_footer.txt
frontend.content: Create a footer with copyright, quick links, and social media icons. Keep it minimal and clean.

backend.name: 01_server.txt
backend.content: Create an Express.js server with CORS, body-parser, and routes for /api/orders, /api/products, /api/analytics. Use port 3000.

backend.name: 02_database.txt
backend.content: Create a SQLite database schema for e-commerce: users, products, orders, order_items tables. Include foreign keys and indexes.

backend.name: 03_routes.txt
backend.content: Create REST API routes for orders: GET /api/orders (list with pagination), POST /api/orders (create), GET /api/orders/:id (single), PUT /api/orders/:id/update-status.

backend.name: 04_auth.txt
backend.content: Add JWT authentication middleware. Login route POST /api/auth/login (validates against users table). Protect /api/orders with auth middleware.
